name: Anvils
note: Anvils repair with their items' materials and by combining two of a kind, join enchantments from books and like items within their highest levels, supported items and exclusive sets, and rename by the typed name (filtered and at most 50 UTF-16 code units, kept for the next items, compared with the names items show in English); prior work penalties, the 39-level cap for renaming, too expensive results and the level cost taken from the player as both official servers give them; the /xp command sets and adds levels and points; 48 steps give the same windows, costs, components and experience as both official servers
deviations: an anvil wears by a random of Circuit's own; the official servers draw it from an unseeded random
stacks with several enchantments keep the left's order with the new ones after it; the official servers keep a hash order of their own
names items show come from the jar's English names: a written book's title, a player head's owner and item_name components are not used
